name: Grok Bot
desc: AI teammates with their own computer that finish jobs around the clock.
desc_zh: 拥有自己电脑的 AI 队友，能登录你的工具并全天候把活儿干完。
solves: Delegating real work means handing over logins and babysitting; a Bot works inside the same apps you do and comes back only for approvals.
solves_zh: 把真活儿派出去就要交账号还得盯着；Bot 在你在用的同一批应用里工作，只在需要批准时才回来。
best_for: You want sales outbound and bug triage handled overnight without giving a stranger your inbox.
best_for_zh: 想让外呼和 bug 分派在夜里完成，又不想把邮箱交给陌生人时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — x.ai/news directory）。 Beta at launch on 2026-08-11 for SuperGrok, SuperGrok Plus and SuperGrok Heavy and for Cursor Pro, Pro+, Ultra and Teams; enterprise access was waitlisted until 2026-09-03. Grok Bot 1.0 (2026-11-11) and Team Bots (2026-09-28) are updates to this product, not separate entries. Bot usage is billed separately from Grok and Cursor plans. 首次公开日期来源：https://x.ai/news/introducing-grok-bot
